description:
Video recording of the course "Geometric Deep Learning" taught in the African Master in Machine Intelligence in July 2022 by Michael Bronstein (Oxford), Joan Bruna (NYU), Taco Cohen (Qualcomm), and Petar Veličković (DeepMind)

Lecture 10: Gauges • Gauge transformations • Examples of gauge symmetry • Weight sharing on manifolds • Geodesic convolution • Gauge-equivariant convolution • HexaConv • Gauge-equivariant Mesh CNNs • Fibre bundles • Principal bundles • Bundle maps • Universality results

Slides: https://www.dropbox.com/s/fj4q3gv17xqpv0r/AIMS%202022%20-%20Lecture%2010%20-%20Gauges.pdf?dl=0

Additional materials: www.geometricdeeplearning.com

chapters.title: Representing a field as a function using a gauge
A global continuous gauge may not exist
Example: Diffusion Tensor Images of the brain
Attempt 1: Weight sharing via global symmetries
Attempt 2: Weight sharing via Parallel transport
Gauge Equivariant Convolution: general case (global gauge)
